nodes.label: Production runbook
nodes.rationale: One Linux VPS per environment. nginx proxies to gunicorn, which talks to MariaDB 10.4. Workers, backups and the web process are separate services so a schema change can stop job claims without stopping the admin path entirely.

nodes.label: VPS process layout
nodes.rationale: timetable-web.service runs gunicorn on port 8000 with BACKGROUND_WORKERS false. timetable-workers.service runs flask workers run: the export queue, the timetable queue, the nightly close-day and the quality-model retrainer. A systemd timer runs deploy/backup.sh nightly. Everything lives under /opt/timetable, owned by the timetable user. Two worker hosts are safe because claims carry locked_by.

nodes.label: First install
nodes.rationale: install.sh sets up packages, the virtualenv, the frontend build, systemd and nginx. One college then runs flask db upgrade, flask seed run and flask admin create-superadmin. Several colleges use flask tenant init and flask tenant create. TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT is 1 for nginx. REQUIRE_MIGRATED_DB and REQUIRE_WORKERS make /health return 503 until the schema is at head and the worker heartbeat is fresh.

nodes.label: Upgrade and rollback
nodes.rationale: Stop the workers so nothing claims jobs while the schema changes, and take a dump before any schema change. If db upgrade stops at 0008 because attendance rows have no session_id, backfill, resolve marks on a cancelled lecture, then upgrade again. Rollback is flask db downgrade or a restore of the pre-upgrade dump, then the previous git tag. Revisions are written so a downgrade removes only what the upgrade added.

nodes.label: Backup and restore drill
nodes.rationale: Nightly backup writes one gzipped dump per database, a tar of uploads, and SHA256SUMS. Restore into a new database name rather than overwriting. MariaDB RENAME is not available across databases, so either point the tenant registry at the restored name or restore with replace after stopping both services. The drill compares counts of users, attendance and lecture_sessions. Repeat it after every MariaDB upgrade. The face template key stays in .env only, out of the database backups.

nodes.label: Health and incidents
nodes.rationale: /health returns 503 when the database is behind, the worker heartbeat is missing or stale, or free disk is below HEALTH_MIN_FREE_MB. A running export or generation whose heartbeat is older than JOB_STALE_SECONDS is requeued. Maintenance mode leaves the admin panel open for Admin, Super Admin and HOD, including /admin/login, while students, teachers and visitors see the maintenance page. Every log line carries a request id that nginx, the app and the access log share.

nodes.label: Secrets rotation
nodes.rationale: Changing SECRET_KEY signs everyone out. MYSQL_PASSWORD must also change in MariaDB. MOBILE_SYNC_API_KEY forces devices to re-register. FACE_TEMPLATE_KEY rotation sets the new key, keeps the old one in FACE_TEMPLATE_KEY_PREVIOUS, restarts, runs flask face rotate-key for every tenant, then removes the previous key.
